# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VWAP_REVERSION_RSI_EXTREME_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the morning trend establishes, price often becomes over‑extended above VWAP with high RSI and declining volume, setting up a mean‑reversion pullback to VWAP. Fading this extension with a short entry captures the reversion edge while avoiding the morning trend‑following bias of existing VWAP_CONTINUATION.

## Mechanism

**Entry (time 11:00‑13:00 ET):**  
- Price > VWAP + 0.3%  
- RSI(14) > 70  
- Volume < 0.7 × average volume of prior 20 bars  
- |EMA8‑EMA21|/price < 0.0005 (ribbon flat, no strong trend)  
If all true, enter short at next bar open.

**Exit:**  
- Stop: most recent swing high (structure) or premium‑stop 0.4%, whichever is tighter.  
- Target: VWAP (mean) or 0.8R, whichever is reached first.  
- Optional runner: if price moves favorably, trail stop 15% off highest low to let a portion run.
